newsitem.title: FRANCE: France welcomes new Zaire parliament speaker.
newsitem.headline: France welcomes new Zaire parliament speaker.

text.p: France on Saturday welcomed Archbishop Laurent Pasinya Monsengwo's election as speaker of Zaire's transition parliament, saying it could help an orderly transfer of power in Kinshasa.
"We rejoice in Archbishop Monsengwo's election and extend our deepest wishes for the success of his mission," a Foreign Ministry spokesman said.
His election appeared to facilitate "an orderly transition (in Zaire) within an institutional and legal framework".
It should also facilitate a second meeting between ailing Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko and rebel leader Laurent Kabila, the spokesman said.
